title: File:Steam Train- 60163 "Tornado" whistles past Twyford, Cathedrals Express to Worcester, 19 March 2013.webm
author: MoiUnMouton
about: This video shows Britain's newest mainline steam locomotive, no 60163 "Tornado", hauling Steam Dreams' "Cathedrals Express" excursion from Tonbridge to Worcester on 19th March 2013. The train is seen passing through Twyford Station at 55mph
